title: The Winner
subject: English
summary: “The Winner” is a story about the importance of hard work, determination and sportsmanship. It teaches us that a true winner is not always the person who comes first but the one who tries their best and never gives up. Through the experiences of the characters, we learn that winning and losing are both parts of life. We should respect others, accept defeat happily and keep trying to improve ourselves. The story teaches us that real success comes from hard work, confidence and a positive attitude.
